partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: LOF enzyme product replacement
results.hypothesis: A chemical product of a LOF disease enzyme can treat the disease by replacing the missing metabolic output.
results.body: LOF disease driver directly produces candidate drug
results.mechanism_rationale: The graph directly links the deficient enzyme to the administered product, representing a concrete replacement mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The enzyme-product and LOF disease paths are directly TRAPI-expressible.
results.cypher:
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:PRODUCES]->(subject:Drug)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: LOF substrate supplementation diagnostic
results.hypothesis: Administering a substrate of a deficient enzyme may worsen substrate accumulation and is matched metabolic negative evidence.
results.body: LOF disease driver has candidate drug as substrate
results.mechanism_rationale: The relation identifies direct exposure to a substrate that the deficient enzyme may fail to clear, but flux direction is not explicit.
results.trapi_notes: The enzyme-substrate and LOF disease paths are directly TRAPI-expressible.

results.name: LOF accumulated-substrate production blockade
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting an alternate enzyme that produces a deficient enzyme's substrate can reduce toxic substrate accumulation.
results.body: LOF driver consumes metabolite; alternate enzyme produces it; drug decreases alternate producer
results.mechanism_rationale: This five-hop rule encodes substrate-reduction therapy with explicit drug direction and distinct producer/consumer enzymes.
results.trapi_notes: The positive metabolic and target paths are TRAPI-expressible; enzyme identity and qualified effect direction require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:HAS_SUBSTRATE]->(metabolite:ChemicalEntity)
      <-[:PRODUCES]-(alternate:Gene)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(alternate)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(alternate)
WHERE alternate <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
WITH subject, driver
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: LOF alternate-product boosting
results.hypothesis: Increasing an alternate enzyme that produces the same metabolite as a LOF driver can restore missing metabolic output.
results.body: LOF driver and alternate enzyme share product; drug increases alternate producer
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule encodes an explicit alternative metabolic route and restorative drug direction, although production edges do not quantify flux.
results.trapi_notes: The metabolic and target paths are TRAPI-expressible; repeated metabolite identity, enzyme distinction, and effect qualifiers require post-processing.

results.body: R239 with alternate producer decreased rather than increased
results.mechanism_rationale: The same alternate metabolic route is retained, but the perturbation direction further reduces product supply.
results.trapi_notes: The metabolic and target paths are TRAPI-expressible; matched sign interpretation and repeated identities require post-processing.
